en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden village store building behind a white picket fence. The central two‑storey house has a steep tiled roof and a sign above the entrance reading "Jømna Handelslag". Bicycles are leaned against the fence, telegraph poles and smaller outbuildings surround the main structure, and forested countryside is visible in the background. In the lower right corner the caption on the postcard reads "Jømna Handelslag" and beneath it a smaller line credits the photographer or printer.
